newsitem.title: USA: Checkers names chairman, gains debt relief.
newsitem.headline: Checkers names chairman, gains debt relief.

text.p: Checkers Drive-In Restaurants Inc said on Friday that it had named Frederick Fisher, one of its existing board members, as chairman.
The company also said it had completed the restructuring of its primary debt under a credit facility with its senior secured lenders.
These include CKE Restaurants Inc, Casa Bonita Inc, Summit Family Restaurants Inc, and Giant Group Ltd.
Under the restructuring, the term of the credit agreement has been extended by one year until July 31, 1999, and the interest rate on the debt has been reduced to 13 percent.
No principal payments are scheduled through the fourth reporting period of fiscal 1997, the company said.
It said the lenders agreed to modify certain financial covenants under the credit agreement, and agreed to provide a short-term revolving line of credit of up to $2.5 million.
In connection with the agreement, Checkers said it issued warrants to buy an aggregate of 20 million shares of its common stock at an exercise price of $0.75 per share.
The company also said its board increased its membership to seven and elected three new members nominated by the lenders.
These include the chairman and chief executive of CKE Restaurants William Foley II, president of CKE Restaurants Thomas Thompson, and Terry Christensen, a director of the Giant Group.
